name: tiktok-shop-ads
description: TikTok Shop affiliate UGC ads — Taglish Ate Host on camera, voiceover clips, silent hero clips, product must match the listing photo.
base_look: Natural daylight in a Filipino home, vertical phone-camera feel, true-to-life colour, slight natural grain.
closing: Clean frame, free of subtitles, captions, watermarks and logos.
visual_rules: Upload the listing photo as a reference image (Flow ingredients) and use it for every clip where the product appears. Pick a model that supports ingredients; check references/platforms.md. The product must look exactly like the photo in every clip: shape, colour, size against hands, logo, parts.

Only the Ate Host speaks, and only in on-camera clips, in sync with her words; her look is a locked Look anchor (face, hair, grey t-shirt, no jewellery). In voiceover and hero clips nobody on screen speaks.
Hands: five fingers, a plausible grip, slow simple actions; show the product doing its job in a tight, steady shot.
No readable text except what is printed on the product itself.
